label: Romans 1:1
text: Paul, a servant of mine, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of my Father,

label: Romans 1:2
text: (Which my Father had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

label: Romans 1:3
text: Concerning me, his Son, Jesus Christ your Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

label: Romans 1:4
text: And declared to be the Son of my Father with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by my resurrection from the dead:

label: Romans 1:5
text: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for my name:

label: Romans 1:6
text: Among whom are ye also called by me:

label: Romans 1:7
text: To all that be in Rome, beloved of my Father, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from my Father, and from me, the Lord Jesus Christ.

label: Romans 1:8
text: First, Paul thanked my Father through me for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

label: Romans 1:9
text: For my Father is Paul's witness, whom he serveth with his spirit in the gospel concerning me, that without ceasing he maketh mention of you always in his prayers;

label: Romans 1:10
text: Making request, if by any means now at length he might have a prosperous journey by the will of my Father to come unto you.

label: Romans 1:11
text: For Paul longed to see you, that he might impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

label: Romans 1:12
text: That is, that he might be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and him.

label: Romans 1:13
text: Now Paul would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes he purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that he might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

label: Romans 1:14
text: Paul was debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

label: Romans 1:15
text: So, as much as in him was, Paul was ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

label: Romans 1:16
text: For Paul was not ashamed of the gospel concerning me: for it is the power of my Father unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

label: Romans 1:17
text: For therein is the righteousness of my Father revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

label: Romans 1:18
text: For the wrath of my Father is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

label: Romans 1:19
text: Because that which may be known of my Father is manifest in them; for my Father hath shewed it unto them.

label: Romans 1:20
text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

label: Romans 1:21
text: Because that, when they knew my Father, they glorified him not as my Father, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

label: Romans 1:22
text: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

label: Romans 1:23
text: And changed the glory of my uncorruptible Father into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

label: Romans 1:24
text: Wherefore my Father also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

label: Romans 1:25
text: Who changed the truth of my Father into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

label: Romans 1:26
text: For this cause my Father gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

label: Romans 1:27
text: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

label: Romans 1:28
text: And even as they did not like to retain my Father in their knowledge, my Father gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

label: Romans 1:29
text: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

label: Romans 1:30
text: Backbiters, haters of my Father, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

label: Romans 1:31
text: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

label: Romans 1:32
text: Who knowing the judgment of my Father, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

label: Romans 2:1
text: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

label: Romans 2:2
text: But we are sure that the judgment of my Father is according to truth against them which commit such things.

label: Romans 2:3
text: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of my Father?

label: Romans 2:4
text: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of my Father leadeth thee to repentance?

label: Romans 2:5
text: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of my Father;

label: Romans 2:6
text: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

label: Romans 2:7
text: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

label: Romans 2:8
text: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

label: Romans 2:9
text: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

label: Romans 2:10
text: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

label: Romans 2:11
text: For there is no respect of persons with my Father.

label: Romans 2:12
text: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

label: Romans 2:13
text: (For not the hearers of the law are just before my Father, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

label: Romans 2:14
text: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

label: Romans 2:15
text: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

label: Romans 2:16
text: In the day when my Father shall judge the secrets of men by me according to my gospel.

label: Romans 2:17
text: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of my Father,

label: Romans 2:18
text: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

label: Romans 2:19
text: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

label: Romans 2:20
text: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

label: Romans 2:21
text: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

label: Romans 2:22
text: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

label: Romans 2:23
text: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou my Father?

label: Romans 2:24
text: For the name of my Father is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

label: Romans 2:25
text: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

label: Romans 2:26
text: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

label: Romans 2:27
text: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

label: Romans 2:28
text: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

label: Romans 2:29
text: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of my Father.

label: Romans 3:1
text: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

label: Romans 3:2
text: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of my Father.

label: Romans 3:3
text: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of my Father without effect?

label: Romans 3:4
text: God forbid: yea, let my Father be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

label: Romans 3:5
text: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of my Father, what shall we say? Is my Father unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

label: Romans 3:6
text: God forbid: for then how shall my Father judge the world?

label: Romans 3:7
text: For if the truth of my Father hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

label: Romans 3:8
text: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

label: Romans 3:9
text: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

label: Romans 3:10
text: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

label: Romans 3:11
text: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

label: Romans 3:12
text: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

label: Romans 3:13
text: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

label: Romans 3:14
text: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

label: Romans 3:15
text: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

label: Romans 3:16
text: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

label: Romans 3:17
text: And the way of peace have they not known:

label: Romans 3:18
text: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

label: Romans 3:19
text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before my Father.

label: Romans 3:20
text: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

label: Romans 3:21
text: But now the righteousness of my Father without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

label: Romans 3:22
text: Even the righteousness of my Father which is by faith in me unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

label: Romans 3:23
text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of my Father;

label: Romans 3:24
text: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in me:

label: Romans 3:25
text: Whom my Father hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in my blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of my Father;

label: Romans 3:26
text: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in me.

label: Romans 3:27
text: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

label: Romans 3:28
text: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

label: Romans 3:29
text: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

label: Romans 3:30
text: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

label: Romans 3:31
text: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

label: Romans 4:1
text: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

label: Romans 4:2
text: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before my Father.

label: Romans 4:3
text: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

label: Romans 4:4
text: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

label: Romans 4:5
text: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

label: Romans 4:6
text: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom my Father imputeth righteousness without works,

label: Romans 4:7
text: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

label: Romans 4:8
text: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

label: Romans 4:9
text: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

label: Romans 4:10
text: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

label: Romans 4:11
text: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

label: Romans 4:12
text: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

label: Romans 4:13
text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

label: Romans 4:14
text: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

label: Romans 4:15
text: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

label: Romans 4:16
text: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

label: Romans 4:17
text: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even my Father, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

label: Romans 4:18
text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

label: Romans 4:19
text: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:

label: Romans 4:20
text: He staggered not at the promise of my Father through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to my Father;

label: Romans 4:21
text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

label: Romans 4:22
text: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

label: Romans 4:23
text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

label: Romans 4:24
text: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up me, your Lord, from the dead;

label: Romans 4:25
text: I was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

label: Romans 5:1
text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with my Father through me, your Lord:

label: Romans 5:2
text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of my Father.

label: Romans 5:3
text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

label: Romans 5:4
text: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

label: Romans 5:5
text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of my Father is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

label: Romans 5:6
text: For when we were yet without strength, in due time I died for the ungodly.

label: Romans 5:7
text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

label: Romans 5:8
text: But my Father commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, I died for us.

label: Romans 5:9
text: Much more then, being now justified by my blood, we shall be saved from wrath through me.

label: Romans 5:10
text: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to my Father by my death, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by my life.

label: Romans 5:11
text: And not only so, but we also joy in my Father through me, your Lord, by whom we have now received the atonement.

label: Romans 5:12
text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

label: Romans 5:13
text: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

label: Romans 5:14
text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of me that was to come.

label: Romans 5:15
text: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of my Father, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, even me, hath abounded unto many.

label: Romans 5:16
text: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

label: Romans 5:17
text: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by me.)

label: Romans 5:18
text: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

label: Romans 5:19
text: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by my obedience shall many be made righteous.

label: Romans 5:20
text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

label: Romans 5:21
text: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by me, your Lord.

label: Romans 6:1
text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

label: Romans 6:2
text: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

label: Romans 6:3
text: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into me were baptized into my death?

label: Romans 6:4
text: Therefore we are buried with me by baptism into death: that like as I was raised up from the dead by the glory of my Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

label: Romans 6:5
text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of my death, we shall be also in the likeness of my resurrection:

label: Romans 6:6
text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with me, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

label: Romans 6:7
text: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

label: Romans 6:8
text: Now if we be dead with me, we believe that we shall also live with me:

label: Romans 6:9
text: Knowing that I, being raised from the dead, die no more; death hath no more dominion over me.

label: Romans 6:10
text: For in that I died, I died unto sin once: but in that I live, I live unto my Father.

label: Romans 6:11
text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto my Father through me, your Lord.

label: Romans 6:12
text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

label: Romans 6:13
text: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto my Father, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto my Father.

label: Romans 6:14
text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

label: Romans 6:15
text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

label: Romans 6:16
text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

label: Romans 6:17
text: But my Father be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

label: Romans 6:18
text: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

label: Romans 6:19
text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

label: Romans 6:20
text: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

label: Romans 6:21
text: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

label: Romans 6:22
text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to my Father, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

label: Romans 6:23
text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of my Father is eternal life through me, your Lord.

label: Romans 7:1
text: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

label: Romans 7:2
text: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

label: Romans 7:3
text: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

label: Romans 7:4
text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by my body; that ye should be married to another, even to me, who am raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto my Father.

label: Romans 7:5
text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

label: Romans 7:6
text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

label: Romans 7:7
text: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, thou hadst not known sin, but by the law: for thou hadst not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

label: Romans 7:8
text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in thee all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

label: Romans 7:9
text: For thou wast alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and thou diedst.

label: Romans 7:10
text: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, thou foundest to be unto death.

label: Romans 7:11
text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived thee, and by it slew thee.

label: Romans 7:12
text: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

label: Romans 7:13
text: Was then that which is good made death unto thee? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in thee by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

label: Romans 7:14
text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but thou art carnal, sold under sin.

label: Romans 7:15
text: For that which thou doest thou allowest not: for what thou wouldest, that doest thou not; but what thou hatest, that doest thou.

label: Romans 7:16
text: If then thou doest that which thou wouldest not, thou consentest unto the law that it is good.

label: Romans 7:17
text: Now then it is no more thou that doest it, but sin that dwelleth in thee.

label: Romans 7:18
text: For thou knowest that in thee (that is, in thy flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with thee; but how to perform that which is good thou findest not.

label: Romans 7:19
text: For the good that thou wouldest thou doest not: but the evil which thou wouldest not, that thou doest.

label: Romans 7:20
text: Now if thou doest that thou wouldest not, it is no more thou that doest it, but sin that dwelleth in thee.

label: Romans 7:21
text: Thou findest then a law, that, when thou wouldest do good, evil is present with thee.

label: Romans 7:22
text: For thou delightest in the law of my Father after the inward man:

label: Romans 7:23
text: But thou seest another law in thy members, warring against the law of thy mind, and bringing thee into captivity to the law of sin which is in thy members.

label: Romans 7:24
text: O wretched man that thou art! who shall deliver thee from the body of this death?

label: Romans 7:25
text: I thank my Father through me, thy Lord. So then with the mind thou thyself servest the law of my Father; but with the flesh the law of sin.

label: Romans 8:1
text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in me, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

label: Romans 8:2
text: For the law of the Spirit of life in me hath made you free from the law of sin and death.

label: Romans 8:3
text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, my Father sending me, his own Son, in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

label: Romans 8:4
text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

label: Romans 8:5
text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

label: Romans 8:6
text: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

label: Romans 8:7
text: Because the carnal mind is enmity against my Father: for it is not subject to the law of my Father, neither indeed can be.

label: Romans 8:8
text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please my Father.

label: Romans 8:9
text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of my Father dwell in you. Now if any man have not my Spirit, he is none of mine.

label: Romans 8:10
text: And if I be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

label: Romans 8:11
text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up me from the dead dwell in you, he that raised me from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

label: Romans 8:12
text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

label: Romans 8:13
text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

label: Romans 8:14
text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of my Father, they are the sons of my Father.

label: Romans 8:15
text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

label: Romans 8:16
text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of my Father:

label: Romans 8:17
text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of my Father, and joint-heirs with me; if so be that we suffer with me, that we may be also glorified together.

label: Romans 8:18
text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

label: Romans 8:19
text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of my Father.

label: Romans 8:20
text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

label: Romans 8:21
text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of my Father.

label: Romans 8:22
text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

label: Romans 8:23
text: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

label: Romans 8:24
text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

label: Romans 8:25
text: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

label: Romans 8:26
text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

label: Romans 8:27
text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of my Father.

label: Romans 8:28
text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love my Father, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

label: Romans 8:29
text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to my image, that I might be the firstborn among many brethren.

label: Romans 8:30
text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

label: Romans 8:31
text: What shall we then say to these things? If my Father be for us, who can be against us?

label: Romans 8:32
text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered me up for us all, how shall he not with me also freely give us all things?

label: Romans 8:33
text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of my Father's elect? It is my Father that justifieth.

label: Romans 8:34
text: Who is he that condemneth? It is I that died, yea rather, that am risen again, who am even at the right hand of my Father, who also make intercession for us.

label: Romans 8:35
text: Who shall separate us from my love? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

label: Romans 8:36
text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

label: Romans 8:37
text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through me that loved you.

label: Romans 8:38
text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

label: Romans 8:39
text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of my Father, which is in me, your Lord.

label: Romans 9:1
text: Paul said the truth in me, he lied not, his conscience also bearing him witness in the Holy Ghost,

label: Romans 9:2
text: That he had great heaviness and continual sorrow in his heart.

label: Romans 9:3
text: For he could wish that himself were accursed from me for his brethren, his kinsmen according to the flesh:

label: Romans 9:4
text: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of my Father, and the promises;

label: Romans 9:5
text: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh I came, who am over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

label: Romans 9:6
text: Not as though the word of my Father hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

label: Romans 9:7
text: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

label: Romans 9:8
text: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of my Father: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

label: Romans 9:9
text: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

label: Romans 9:10
text: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

label: Romans 9:11
text: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of my Father according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

label: Romans 9:12
text: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

label: Romans 9:13
text: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

label: Romans 9:14
text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with my Father? God forbid.

label: Romans 9:15
text: For my Father saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

label: Romans 9:16
text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of my Father that sheweth mercy.

label: Romans 9:17
text: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

label: Romans 9:18
text: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

label: Romans 9:19
text: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

label: Romans 9:20
text: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against my Father? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

label: Romans 9:21
text: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

label: Romans 9:22
text: What if my Father, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

label: Romans 9:23
text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

label: Romans 9:24
text: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

label: Romans 9:25
text: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

label: Romans 9:26
text: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

label: Romans 9:27
text: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

label: Romans 9:28
text: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

label: Romans 9:29
text: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

label: Romans 9:30
text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

label: Romans 9:31
text: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

label: Romans 9:32
text: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

label: Romans 9:33
text: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

label: Romans 10:1
text: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to my Father for Israel is, that they might be saved.

label: Romans 10:2
text: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of my Father, but not according to knowledge.

label: Romans 10:3
text: For they being ignorant of my Father's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of my Father.

label: Romans 10:4
text: For I am the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

label: Romans 10:5
text: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

label: Romans 10:6
text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring me down from above:)

label: Romans 10:7
text: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring me up again from the dead.)

label: Romans 10:8
text: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

label: Romans 10:9
text: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth me as Lord, and shalt believe in thine heart that my Father hath raised me from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

label: Romans 10:10
text: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

label: Romans 10:11
text: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

label: Romans 10:12
text: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for I, the same Lord over all, am rich unto all that call upon me.

label: Romans 10:13
text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

label: Romans 10:14
text: How then shall they call on me in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in me of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

label: Romans 10:15
text: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

label: Romans 10:16
text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

label: Romans 10:17
text: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of my Father.

label: Romans 10:18
text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

label: Romans 10:19
text: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

label: Romans 10:20
text: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

label: Romans 10:21
text: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

label: Romans 11:1
text: I say then, Hath my Father cast away his people? God forbid. For Paul also was an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

label: Romans 11:2
text: My Father hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to my Father against Israel, saying,

label: Romans 11:3
text: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

label: Romans 11:4
text: But what saith the answer of my Father unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

label: Romans 11:5
text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

label: Romans 11:6
text: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

label: Romans 11:7
text: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

label: Romans 11:8
text: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

label: Romans 11:9
text: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

label: Romans 11:10
text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

label: Romans 11:11
text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

label: Romans 11:12
text: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

label: Romans 11:13
text: For Paul spake to you Gentiles, inasmuch as he was the apostle of the Gentiles, he magnified his office:

label: Romans 11:14
text: If by any means he might provoke to emulation them which were his flesh, and might save some of them.

label: Romans 11:15
text: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

label: Romans 11:16
text: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

label: Romans 11:17
text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

label: Romans 11:18
text: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

label: Romans 11:19
text: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

label: Romans 11:20
text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

label: Romans 11:21
text: For if my Father spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

label: Romans 11:22
text: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of my Father: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

label: Romans 11:23
text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for my Father is able to graff them in again.

label: Romans 11:24
text: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

label: Romans 11:25
text: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

label: Romans 11:26
text: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

label: Romans 11:27
text: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

label: Romans 11:28
text: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.

label: Romans 11:29
text: For the gifts and calling of my Father are without repentance.

label: Romans 11:30
text: For as ye in times past have not believed my Father, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

label: Romans 11:31
text: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

label: Romans 11:32
text: For my Father hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

label: Romans 11:33
text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of my Father! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

label: Romans 11:34
text: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

label: Romans 11:35
text: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

label: Romans 11:36
text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

label: Romans 12:1
text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of my Father, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto my Father, which is your reasonable service.

label: Romans 12:2
text: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of my Father.

label: Romans 12:3
text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as my Father hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

label: Romans 12:4
text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

label: Romans 12:5
text: So we, being many, are one body in me, and every one members one of another.

label: Romans 12:6
text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

label: Romans 12:7
text: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

label: Romans 12:8
text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

label: Romans 12:9
text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

label: Romans 12:10
text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

label: Romans 12:11
text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving me;

label: Romans 12:12
text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

label: Romans 12:13
text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

label: Romans 12:14
text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

label: Romans 12:15
text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

label: Romans 12:16
text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

label: Romans 12:17
text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

label: Romans 12:18
text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

label: Romans 12:19
text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

label: Romans 12:20
text: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

label: Romans 12:21
text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

label: Romans 13:1
text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of my Father: the powers that be are ordained of my Father.

label: Romans 13:2
text: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of my Father: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

label: Romans 13:3
text: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

label: Romans 13:4
text: For he is the minister of my Father to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of my Father, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

label: Romans 13:5
text: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

label: Romans 13:6
text: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are my Father's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

label: Romans 13:7
text: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

label: Romans 13:8
text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

label: Romans 13:9
text: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

label: Romans 13:10
text: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

label: Romans 13:11
text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

label: Romans 13:12
text: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

label: Romans 13:13
text: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

label: Romans 13:14
text: But put ye on me, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

label: Romans 14:1
text: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

label: Romans 14:2
text: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

label: Romans 14:3
text: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for my Father hath received him.

label: Romans 14:4
text: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for my Father is able to make him stand.

label: Romans 14:5
text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

label: Romans 14:6
text: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto me; and he that regardeth not the day, to me he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to me, for he giveth my Father thanks; and he that eateth not, to me he eateth not, and giveth my Father thanks.

label: Romans 14:7
text: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

label: Romans 14:8
text: For whether we live, we live unto me; and whether we die, we die unto me: whether we live therefore, or die, we are mine.

label: Romans 14:9
text: For to this end I both died, and rose, and revived, that I might be Lord both of the dead and living.

label: Romans 14:10
text: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before my judgment seat.

label: Romans 14:11
text: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

label: Romans 14:12
text: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to my Father.

label: Romans 14:13
text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

label: Romans 14:14
text: I know, and am persuaded, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

label: Romans 14:15
text: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom I died.

label: Romans 14:16
text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

label: Romans 14:17
text: For the kingdom of my Father is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

label: Romans 14:18
text: For he that in these things serveth me is acceptable to my Father, and approved of men.

label: Romans 14:19
text: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

label: Romans 14:20
text: For meat destroy not the work of my Father. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.

label: Romans 14:21
text: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

label: Romans 14:22
text: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before my Father. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

label: Romans 14:23
text: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

label: Romans 15:1
text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

label: Romans 15:2
text: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

label: Romans 15:3
text: For even I pleased not myself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

label: Romans 15:4
text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

label: Romans 15:5
text: Now my Father, the God of patience and consolation, grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to me:

label: Romans 15:6
text: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify my Father, even the Father of me, your Lord.

label: Romans 15:7
text: Wherefore receive ye one another, as I also received you to the glory of my Father.

label: Romans 15:8
text: Now I say that I was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of my Father, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

label: Romans 15:9
text: And that the Gentiles might glorify my Father for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

label: Romans 15:10
text: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

label: Romans 15:11
text: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

label: Romans 15:12
text: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

label: Romans 15:13
text: Now my Father, the God of hope, fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

label: Romans 15:14
text: And Paul himself also was persuaded of you, brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

label: Romans 15:15
text: Nevertheless, brethren, Paul hath written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to him of my Father,

label: Romans 15:16
text: That he should be a minister of mine to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of my Father, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

label: Romans 15:17
text: He hath therefore whereof he might glory through me in those things which pertain to my Father.

label: Romans 15:18
text: For he would not dare to speak of any of those things which I have not wrought by him, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

label: Romans 15:19
text: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of my Father; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, he hath fully preached my gospel.

label: Romans 15:20
text: Yea, so hath he strived to preach the gospel, not where I was named, lest he should build upon another man's foundation:

label: Romans 15:21
text: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

label: Romans 15:22
text: For which cause also Paul hath been much hindered from coming to you.

label: Romans 15:23
text: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

label: Romans 15:24
text: Whensoever he taketh his journey into Spain, he will come to you: for he trusteth to see you in his journey, and to be brought on his way thitherward by you, if first he be somewhat filled with your company.

label: Romans 15:25
text: But now he goeth unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

label: Romans 15:26
text: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

label: Romans 15:27
text: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

label: Romans 15:28
text: When therefore he hath performed this, and hath sealed to them this fruit, he will come by you into Spain.

label: Romans 15:29
text: And he is sure that, when he cometh unto you, he shall come in the fulness of the blessing of my gospel.

label: Romans 15:30
text: Now Paul beseecheth you, brethren, for my sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with him in your prayers to my Father for him;

label: Romans 15:31
text: That he may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judea; and that his service which he hath for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

label: Romans 15:32
text: That he may come unto you with joy by the will of my Father, and may with you be refreshed.

label: Romans 15:33
text: Now my Father, the God of peace, be with you all. Amen.

label: Romans 16:1
text: Paul commendeth unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

label: Romans 16:2
text: That ye receive her in me, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of him also.

label: Romans 16:3
text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila his helpers in me:

label: Romans 16:4
text: Who have for his life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only he giveth thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

label: Romans 16:5
text: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute his wellbeloved Epenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto me.

label: Romans 16:6
text: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

label: Romans 16:7
text: Salute Andronicus and Junia, his kinsmen, and his fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in me before him.

label: Romans 16:8
text: Greet Amplias his beloved in me.

label: Romans 16:9
text: Salute Urbane, our helper in me, and Stachys his beloved.

label: Romans 16:10
text: Salute Apelles approved in me. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.

label: Romans 16:11
text: Salute Herodion his kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in me.

label: Romans 16:12
text: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in me. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in me.

label: Romans 16:13
text: Salute Rufus chosen in me, and his mother and Paul's.

label: Romans 16:14
text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

label: Romans 16:15
text: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

label: Romans 16:16
text: Salute one another with an holy kiss. My churches salute you.

label: Romans 16:17
text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

label: Romans 16:18
text: For they that are such serve not me, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

label: Romans 16:19
text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

label: Romans 16:20
text: And my Father, the God of peace, shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. My grace be with you. Amen.

label: Romans 16:21
text: Timotheus Paul's workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, his kinsmen, salute you.

label: Romans 16:22
text: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in me.

label: Romans 16:23
text: Gaius Paul's host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

label: Romans 16:24
text: My grace be with you all. Amen.

label: Romans 16:25
text: Now to my Father, that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and my preaching, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

label: Romans 16:26
text: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of my everlasting Father, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

label: Romans 16:27
text: To my Father only wise, be glory through me for ever. Amen. Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
